name: learnonline
description: Online learning platform: React client, Express API, PostgreSQL. Scripts delegate to each package.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix client test -- --run
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix client run build
